about.title: About · BFRadar · BlackFridayRadar
about.description: What BFRadar covers, how prices are estimated, sponsorship, and the disclaimer.
about.heading: About BFRadar
about.lead: BFRadar (BlackFridayRadar) gathers Black Friday and Cyber Monday VPS and hosting deals from LowEndTalk, LowEndSpirit, LowEndBox, NodeSeek and other communities in one place, with plan specs, original prices, CNY estimates and coupon codes, so you can compare them side by side. We only cover VPS, dedicated servers, web hosting and storage; email, domains, colocation and the like are left out. We don't sell hosting, and providers don't pay us.
about.scope.title: What the three ranges mean
about.scope.bf: Deals posted this season (since {season}) and identified as Black Friday or Cyber Monday offers. The home page shows this range by default.
about.scope.promo: All deals posted this season, including Halloween, Singles' Day and other events, and year-round plans.
about.scope.all: No date limit, including year-round threads from past seasons.
about.price.title: How prices are calculated
about.price.original: The start price is the price and billing period as written in the original post, for example $10/yr or €3/mo.
about.price.cny: “≈ ¥N/yr” converts it to a yearly price in CNY at that day's exchange rate: monthly × 12, quarterly × 4, semi-annual × 2, biennial ÷ 2, triennial ÷ 3, hourly × 8760. One-time payments and unclear billing periods aren't converted.
about.price.note: It's only an estimate, without taxes or payment fees; the provider's checkout is what counts.
about.disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
about.disclaimer.price: Prices and terms are as stated by each provider, who may change prices or pull offers at any time.
about.disclaimer.advice: We only aggregate public information. Nothing here is purchase advice, and we aren't responsible for any provider's service or support.
about.disclaimer.auto: Fields are extracted automatically and can be wrong. Where they differ from the original post, the post is right.
about.disclaimer.links: Apart from the sponsor link described under Sponsorship, external links are the original addresses of posts and provider pages, without affiliate parameters, and marked nofollow.
about.privacy.title: Privacy
about.privacy.text: No accounts, no cookies, and no third-party scripts, fonts or analytics.
